question:

ZCD ∶ XAB ∶∶ MDV ∶ KBT ∶∶ RNT ∶ ?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png]

ZCD ∶ XAB

MDV ∶ KBT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e90a2f1f453a96dd455deca414b5d5d0266b71fc18bacc984867eb7c5d1c784.png] 

Similarly, RNT ∶ ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c1e808c76c717381ff5a98ab65588407c577e35bba737116bb50ee7a718e626.png]
